metadata.title: Why Anthropic's AI agent push is good news for AMD - MarketWatch

content.text:
10 hours ago
Why Anthropic's AI agent push is good news for AMD
Anthropic's prospectus provides a strong signal for makers of central processing units, according to Raymond James analysts led by Simon Leopold.
The analysts cited the adoption of Claude Cowork, an artificial-intelligence agent, which has outpaced Claude Code, "suggesting agentic workloads are spreading well beyond developers." Anthropic also recently unveiled Claude Duet, a "proactive agent" geared toward professionals.
"Agentic applications should broaden infrastructure demand toward server CPUs," Leopold wrote in a Monday client note, calling that a positive for Advanced Micro Devices and other manufacturers that use Arm-based designs.
